issue.title: Release coordinated outcome
issue.body:
## Problem Statement

Two units must converge under one truthful outcome.

## Solution

Release one coordinated outcome.

## User Stories

1. As a maintainer, I want both leaves verified before roll-up.

## Implementation Decisions

Use native issue relationships.

## Testing Decisions

Use leaf checks and integrated health.

## Out of Scope

A local lifecycle mirror.

## Further Notes

No external mutation in this fixture.
